tftp_root.description: Root directory where TFTP files are served from. Must exist and be readable.

tftp_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to *only* use for TFTP traffic (restricts TFTP to these).

tftp_no_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to *exclude* from TFTP service.

tftp_bind_addresses.description: List of IP addresses to bind TFTP service to. If omitted, binds to all interfaces.

tftp_boot_file.description: Name of the default boot file served (e.g., 'pxelinux.0' or 'grubaa64.efi'). Optional.

pxe_prompt.description: Text prompt shown before PXE boot menu (e.g., 'Press F8 for boot menu'). Optional.

pxe_services.description: List of PXE service entries (boot menu items). Each defines a boot option shown during PXE.

name.description: Human-readable label for this service (used only in comment).

desc.description: Description string shown in boot menu.

bootfile.description: Optional specific boot file for this entry (overrides global 'tftp_boot_file').

tftp_port.description: UDP port for TFTP server. 0 = use IANA standard port 69. Change only if needed.

tftp_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous TFTP connections.

tftp_blocksize.description: Maximum TFTP block size (in bytes). RFC 2348 allows up to 65464. Default 512 (legacy).

tftp_no_fail.description: If true, TFTP is read-only (no file uploads). If false, allow writes (not recommended for most uses).

tftp_unique_root.description: If true, allows TFTP option negotiation (e.g., blksize). Usually safe to leave true.
